text:
Maya (eng-platform): Heads-up — planning an east->west DB cutover for the user_profiles migration this Friday 01:00-02:00 UTC. Need deploy owner + smoke checks + rollback owner. Who can be on-call for the window?

Derek (eng-platform): I can own the deploy and rollout steps. I'll be on-call for the window.

Olivia (DB): Backfill progress: finished chunking and queued last batch @ 21:30 UTC. Estimated 30m to drain. No schema locks pending.

Samir (SRE): Thanks. Do we have a defined smoke checklist? latency + basic reads/writes + cache warm? Also want to validate replica lag thresholds before cutover.

Maya (eng-platform): Smoke checklist (short): 1) sanity reads for 5 critical user flows 2) single-user write + read verify 3) replication lag < 5s on replicas 4) API deploy smoke with v2 feature flag off.

Derek (eng-platform): I'll run smoke. Plan: cut traffic to new schema behind feature flag, run smoke suite, shift small % canary (5m), then 50%, then 100% if green. Rollback plan: flip flag back + restore old write routing (script).

Olivia (DB): Confirmed backups taken at 00:40 UTC and snapshot exported to s3://redwood-db-snapshots/user_profiles/pre-cutover-246900. Also setting read-only on staging copy for final check.

Samir (SRE): Adding automated checks to the smoke run: command below (will be run from ci-runner):
```
./smoke/run_smoke.sh --suite=users --target=https://staging-api.redwood.internal --retries=2
```
Will fail the rollout on non-zero exit.

Derek (eng-platform): Noted. I'll also watch query latency p99 and token budget. If any p99 > 800ms or error rate > 0.5% during canary we abort.

Maya (eng-platform): @deploy-bot can you schedule the deploy window and notify oncall?

deploy-bot: Deploy window scheduled: 2026-03-20 01:00 UTC -> 02:00 UTC. Owners: Derek (deploy), Olivia (db), Samir (rollback monitor). Pager: ops-oncall. Link: https://console.redwood.ai/deploys/246900-cutover

Olivia (DB): Quick note — dual-write will be enabled for 15 minutes post-cutover to validate writes on both schema versions. We'll run a consistency job after 10m to check diffs. If diffs > 0.1% by keyspace we trigger rollback.

Derek (eng-platform): For rollback steps (short): 1) flip feature flag 2) run write-reroute script: `scripts/reroute_writes.sh revert` 3) notify ops to re-open maintenance. I have the script and permissions.

Samir (SRE): I'll put a short runbook snippet in the incident channel and wire an automated alert for replication lag and consumer backlog.

Maya (eng-platform): Final checklist for Friday: - Derek: deploy owner ✅ - Olivia: backup + backfill ✅ - Samir: smoke automation + alerts ✅ - Maya: coordinate comms + postmortem template ✅

Derek (eng-platform): I'll post a quick post-deploy message in #eng-platform with smoke results and metrics.

Olivia (DB): One more: if we hit an unexpected schema constraint error, we abort and run `db/rollforward-stats.sh` to gather diagnostics before roll-back.

Maya (eng-platform): Great. Thanks team. If anything changes ping here. :thumbsup:

Derek (eng-platform): 5min heads-up on Friday I'll post in this thread before cutover starts.

Samir (SRE): Copy. Will monitor and standby. :eyes:

deploy-bot: Reminder will fire 30m before window start.
